id: title:haacked:fail group flags when the group type lookup fails

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the Rust implementation of the HogQL flag matching engine, specifically how it handles group type lookup failures and propagates those failures to flag evaluation, and adds documentation and tests for this behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining that a group type lookup timeout now returns a specific error code and that certain conditions depend on the lookup. P1.F1.H1: "When the group type lookup stops at the deadline, a flag whose answer depends on a group condition also returns `timeout:persons_db_deadline`, unless another of its conditions settles the answer."
observations.code_quote: When the group type lookup stops at the deadline, a flag whose answer depends on a group condition also returns `timeout:persons_db_deadline`, unless another of its conditions settles the answer.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of a change in flag evaluation behavior, specifically how group type lookup failures propagate to flag evaluation. This could help users understand why a flag might return a timeout error instead of false or true.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining that a group filter fails closed unless the mapping resolves its group type index. P1.F2.H1: "A group filter fails closed unless the mapping resolves its group type index: a loaded mapping that lacks the index — a cache entry from before the group type was added — says nothing about that group."
observations.code_quote: A failed lookup says nothing about any group in the request, so a condition that aggregates by a group or filters on a group property cannot be evaluated when the request sends group context.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of a change in flag evaluation behavior, specifically how group type lookup failures propagate to flag evaluation. This could help users understand why a flag might return a timeout error instead of false or true.

observations.posthog_connection: Adds a dependency on Arc, which is used for shared ownership of references. This could be used to share ownership of a FlagError across multiple locations, potentially improving performance or reducing memory usage.
